effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn. Then, if it's your turn, 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into [Silphymon] in the hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
